cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: Helpful Culprit
cards.instruction: Hide that the problem is your fault while enthusiastically helping investigate it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm only here to sweep up. Leave the broken vase where it is; I'll work out what happened before anyone moves the table.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent, we've got a starting point. I'll check whether the table wobbles. You can write down which leg looks shortest.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's a piece of vase stuck in your bag strap.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A useful clue. I'll keep the bag with me so nothing gets dislodged. You finish with the table legs; we mustn't lose that line of inquiry.
